description: iOS 26 Liquid Glass search screen structural guardrails for implementation-ready design SSOT.

forbiddenSelectors.message: External Material Symbols font usage is forbidden in this HTML design repository.
Floating action buttons are forbidden in the iOS 26 search screen contract.
iPhone landscape must keep iOS tab bar navigation, not a sidebar/nav rail.
iPhone landscape must remain single-pane and must not use the former left-rail pattern.
iPad frames must use top-aligned tab bar, not bottom UITabBar.

requiredText: Search Screen — Design SSOT (医薬品・疾患リファレンス) — iOS 26 (Liquid Glass)
implementation source evidence + rendered frame evidence
Floating action buttons (FAB) are a Material 3 pattern and are forbidden on iOS 26

requiredSelectors.message: Repo-wide readiness marker must be present.
iOS 26 search SSOT must declare the 80-frame matrix.
iOS 26 search SSOT must keep 9 phone states and 7 states for the four utility device classes.
iOS 26 Reduce Transparency and minimized tab bar contracts must remain explicit.
History limit, page size, and loading skeleton count must stay explicit.
iPad Split View contract must remain explicit.
iPhone bottom-nav requirement must remain declared.
iPad top-tab-bar requirement must remain declared.
iPad utility pane requirement must remain declared.
